assets.name: fixed-printer-frame-with-varying-palmette-bands
assets.description: An original fixed printer frame with varying palmette and curled-scroll bands. Part of the Schön Neues Modelbuch (Page 2 recto) (met-680571) set.

extraction.method: Native-resolution continuous ink coverage after locally measured paper removal; PNG appearance master.
extraction.source_rgb_modified: Paper removed by measured ink coverage; RGB is the scan-measured ink tone, not an exact source-pixel crop.

review.notes: Complete original motif periods inspected before local native phase matching. Source ink and continuous alpha retained, all interior columns unchanged; only documented two-pixel matching collars averaged. Five-cycle strips and all four phase-derived miter corners inspected on white/dark; fixed frame keeps actual varied bands/corners. Cleaner bow impression chosen after four originals compared, no paper-fold blot repeated. Rotated units and bars are exact native 90-degree turns. No faceted trace.

assets.usage_notes: Original fixed frame with all actual corners and different upper/lower bands retained. Center text and letter excluded, paper transparent. This whole original complements the separately audited original repeat units; it is not a generated frame.
